name: Asia Poly Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司就Asia Poly Industrial与PT. Huasu Poly Industry的MOU、以及Ecogreen Monomer与Sumitomo Corporation Asia & Oceania及Sumima的MOU多次公告，均表示自上次公告以来无重大进展。此外，公司就经常性关联交易寻求新的股东授权，并续期现有授权。
overview_en: In 2026, the company made multiple announcements regarding the MOU between Asia Poly Industrial and PT. Huasu Poly Industry, and the MOU between Ecogreen Monomer and Sumitomo Corporation Asia & Oceania together with Sumima, stating no material development since the last announcements. The company also sought a new shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions and renewed the existing mandate.

segments.name: 制造
segments.note: 公司就Asia Poly Industrial与PT. Huasu Poly Industry的MOU持续更新状态，年内无重大进展。
segments.note_en: The company continued to update the status of the MOU between Asia Poly Industrial and PT. Huasu Poly Industry, with no material development during the year.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 更新Asia Poly Industrial Sdn. Bhd.与PT. Huasu Poly Industry的MOU状态，自2026年5月29日公告以来无重大进展。
actions.text_en: Updated the status of the MOU between Asia Poly Industrial Sdn. Bhd. and PT. Huasu Poly Industry, with no material development since the announcement on 29 May 2026.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 更新Asia Poly Industrial Sdn. Bhd.与PT. Huasu Poly Industry的MOU状态，自2026年2月27日公告以来无重大进展。
actions.text_en: Updated the status of the MOU between Asia Poly Industrial Sdn. Bhd. and PT. Huasu Poly Industry, with no material development since the announcement on 27 February 2026.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 公告Asia Poly Industrial Sdn. Bhd.与PT. Huasu Poly Industry于2025年10月30日签订的MOU，自签订以来无重大进展。
actions.text_en: Announced that the MOU dated 30 October 2025 between Asia Poly Industrial Sdn. Bhd. and PT. Huasu Poly Industry has no material development since signing.

segments.name: 可再生能源
segments.note: 公司就Ecogreen Monomer与Sumitomo Corporation Asia & Oceania及Sumima的MOU持续更新状态，年内无重大进展。
segments.note_en: The company continued to update the status of the MOU between Ecogreen Monomer and Sumitomo Corporation Asia & Oceania together with Sumima, with no material development during the year.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 更新Ecogreen Monomer Sdn. Bhd.与Sumitomo Corporation Asia & Oceania Pte. Ltd.及Sumima Sdn. Bhd.的MOU状态，自2026年5月29日公告以来无重大进展。
actions.text_en: Updated the status of the MOU between Ecogreen Monomer Sdn. Bhd. and Sumitomo Corporation Asia & Oceania Pte. Ltd. together with Sumima Sdn. Bhd., with no material development since the announcement on 29 May 2026.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 更新Ecogreen Monomer Sdn. Bhd.与Sumitomo Corporation Asia & Oceania Pte. Ltd.及Sumima Sdn. Bhd.的MOU状态，自2026年2月27日公告以来无重大进展。
actions.text_en: Updated the status of the MOU between Ecogreen Monomer Sdn. Bhd. and Sumitomo Corporation Asia & Oceania Pte. Ltd. together with Sumima Sdn. Bhd., with no material development since the announcement on 27 February 2026.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 公告Ecogreen Monomer Sdn. Bhd.与Sumitomo Corporation Asia & Oceania Pte. Ltd.及Sumima Sdn. Bhd.的MOU，自2025年11月17日以来无重大进展。
actions.text_en: Announced that the MOU between Ecogreen Monomer Sdn. Bhd. and Sumitomo Corporation Asia & Oceania Pte. Ltd. together with Sumima Sdn. Bhd. has no material development since 17 November 2025.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 公司就经常性关联交易寻求新的股东授权并续期现有授权。
segments.note_en: The company sought a new shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions and renewed the existing mandate.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以在即将召开的特别股东大会上寻求批准。
actions.text_en: Proposed new shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions to be tabled for approval at the forthcoming Extraordinary General Meeting.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以在即将召开的年度股东大会上寻求批准。
actions.text_en: Proposed renewal of shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions to be tabled for approval at the forthcoming Annual General Meeting.
